First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12–14 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Shifty Freewheelers Monday Night Ride group ride

A Monday night no-drop ride out of Deep Ellum. Any kind of bike works. About 15 miles at 12 to 14 mph and the route changes. The start sometimes moves, so check the Shifty Freewheelers Facebook group first.
